faqs.a:
A person commits the crime of criminal tampering if that person tampers with property
               of another with intent to cause injury, inconvenience, or annoyance to that person
               or to another or if he knowingly makes an unauthorized connection with property of
               a utility.
(Ord. No.
4847
, § 3, 7-10-2023)
